subject: Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance Update
overview: The committee met with planning consultant Innes Associates to review a detailed work plan and citywide mapping analysis for comprehensive zoning ordinance updates. The committee voted to keep the matter in committee, planning upcoming discussions focused on the Mystic Avenue and Salem Street corridors and an in-person working session on the maps.

items.title: Zoning ordinance updates work plan and mapping analysis
items.summary: Innes Associates presented an updated work plan organized by goals and timelines—prioritizing the Mystic Avenue and Salem Street corridors—along with twenty analytical maps covering transit, hydrology, demographics, and parcel dimensions. Kept in committee.
